WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ENGINEERING - GAMES
What We Do
Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.
What You'll Do
As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.
In this role, you will
Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products
Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance
Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms
Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap
What we're looking for
PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience
Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems
Expert, hands-on knowledge of:
Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models
Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling
Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.
ABOUT US
Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience. The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes. Success in this role comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through a combination of business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered, while driving long-term organizational success and adaptability in a rapidly evolving business landscape. jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across the Netherlands' largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Government, Healthcare & Utilities. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Dutch public sector bodies, healthcare organizations, and utilities providers — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology. In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies. In this role you will: 1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across the Netherlands, with a primary focus on Government, Healthcare & Utilities, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals. 2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for government bodies, healthcare organizations, and utilities providers. 3. Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers. 4. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to regulated Dutch government, healthcare, and utilities organizations. 5. Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants. 6. Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Dutch government, healthcare, and utilities sectors, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures, including public tender processes. 7. Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts. 8. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents. Requirements 1. 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms. 2. Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement. 3. Well-connected in the Dutch government, healthcare, and utilities landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level. 4. Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value. 5. Deep understanding of enterprise and public sector procurement and legal processes in the Netherlands, including tender and RFP processes, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures. 6. Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly. 7. Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers. 8. A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale. 9. Native or full professional proficiency in Dutch; strong English for internal collaboration. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the Netherlands with the ability to travel to client sites when required. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description: Communications & People Engagement Lead Description - The Communications & People Engagement Lead is a strategic partner responsible for shaping organizational culture, driving employee engagement, strengthening leadership communications, and enabling successful change adoption across the Global Customer Care Centers (CCC) organization. This role serves as the connective tissue between leadership, employees, and business priorities assuring that communication is not merely informational, but transformational. The individual will design and execute integrated communication, engagement, culture, recognition, and change management strategies that foster connection, transparency, inclusion, and organizational effectiveness across a globally distributed workforce. The role requires a highly creative, customer-centric, and influential communications professional capable of translating business priorities into meaningful employee experiences that build trust, drive alignment, accelerate adoption of change, and strengthen employee commitment to organizational goals. Working closely with Customer Care Center leadership, Operations, Quality, Training, HR, Communications, and other business stakeholders, the Communications & People Engagement Lead will help build a connected, resilient, engaged, and future-ready workforce while elevating employee experience across all care center locations. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Communications Organizational Communications Strategy Develop and execute integrated communications strategies aligned to CCC business priorities, transformation initiatives, and organizational objectives. Serve as the primary communications advisor to CCC leadership, shaping messaging that drives clarity, engagement, and alignment. Build annual communication roadmaps and engagement calendars supporting strategic priorities. Ensure consistent, timely, and effective communication across global teams, sites, and functions. Establish communication standards, governance, and best practices across the organization. Executive & Leadership Communications Develop executive-level messaging, presentations, speeches, town halls, leadership updates, and employee communications. Support leadership engagement sessions, all-employee meetings, fireside chats, podcasts, and interactive forums. Partner with leaders to strengthen visibility, accessibility, and connection with employees. Coach leaders on communication effectiveness, storytelling, and employee engagement approaches. Communication Content Management Own and manage end-to-end communication channels and content strategies. Create and distribute: Newsletters Leadership updates Internal campaigns Employee stories Organizational announcements Transformation communications Recognition communications Ensuring content reflects organizational values, culture, and customer-focused priorities. 2. Storytelling, Branding & Employee Advocacy Strategic Storytelling Develop compelling narratives that connect employees to purpose, customers, business outcomes, and organizational strategy. Translate complex business concepts into engaging, relatable, and actionable content. Create storytelling frameworks that highlight innovation, customer impact, quality, transformation, and employee success. Employee & Customer Impact Stories Identify and amplify stories showcasing employee contributions, customer outcomes, operational excellence, and business impact. Partner with leaders and teams to celebrate achievements and successes across geographies. Build internal advocacy programs that increase employee pride and organizational connection. Creative Content Development Lead innovative communication approaches leveraging: Visual storytelling Infographics Video communications Digital campaigns Podcasts Interactive experiences Executive narratives Employee spotlights Social and collaboration platforms 3. Employee Engagement & Culture Employee Experience Strategy Design and implement programs that strengthen employee engagement, belonging, motivation, and connection. Partner with HR and leadership teams to improve employee experience across the employee lifecycle. Develop initiatives that align employee sentiment with organizational goals and values. Recognition & Appreciation Programs Lead enterprise recognition strategies that celebrate performance, innovation, customer obsession, teamwork, and cultural excellence. Establish scalable global recognition programs and engagement events. Drive employee appreciation initiatives that reinforce desired organizational behaviors. Inclusion, Belonging & Community Champion an inclusive culture where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered. Build engagement initiatives that foster collaboration across countries, cultures, functions, and teams. Partner with employee resource groups and community networks to create meaningful employee experiences. Employee Listening Programs Design and manage employee listening strategies including: Pulse surveys Focus groups Listening sessions Engagement assessments Sentiment analysis Translate employee feedback into actionable recommendations. Ensure leadership accountability through continuous feedback loops and action planning. 4. Change Management & Organizational Adoption Management of Change (MoC) Lead communication and engagement workstreams supporting organizational transformation programs. Develop comprehensive change communication strategies and adoption plans. Ensure employees understand the rationale, benefits, risks, and impacts of transformation initiatives. Change Communications Create and implement communication plans covering: Business rationale for change Strategic objectives Employee impacts New ways of working Adoption expectations Success outcomes Ongoing progress updates Change Champion Network Build and manage global networks of change champions. Enable champions with training, messaging, communication assets, and engagement tools. Drive local advocacy and adoption across regions and teams. Adoption & Readiness Management Measure awareness, readiness, engagement, and adoption of key initiatives. Identify resistance points and engagement risks. Develop mitigation strategies and targeted interventions. Track organizational readiness and communication effectiveness. 5. Leadership Engagement & Organizational Effectiveness Leadership Partnership Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on employee engagement, communications, culture, and change initiatives. Provide insights and recommendations that improve organizational effectiveness and employee connection. Employee Engagement Events Lead planning and execution of: Global All Employee Meetings Leadership forums Town halls Engagement weeks Recognition ceremonies Cultural celebrations Volunteer and community activities Learning and development events Global Collaboration Foster collaboration across sites, partners, suppliers, and functional organizations. Encourage sharing of best practices, knowledge, and organizational success stories. 6. Employee Relations & Interpersonal Effectiveness Employee Advocacy Champion employee concerns, perspectives, and ideas. Promote transparent communication and trust across the organization. Active Listening & Empathy Create environments where employees feel heard, respected, and supported. Strengthen leadership understanding of employee needs and experiences. Conflict Resolution & Engagement Support Facilitate constructive dialogue and partnership across teams. Support resolution of communication, engagement, and adoption challenges. Promote collaboration and positive working relationships. Success Measures Performance will be measured through: Communication Excellence Employee awareness and understanding of organizational priorities. Communication reach, engagement, and effectiveness. Leadership communication satisfaction metrics. Quality and timeliness of communication delivery. Employee Engagement Improvements in engagement and sentiment indicators. Participation in engagement programs and activities. Recognition program adoption and impact. Employee advocacy and connection measures. Change Adoption Change readiness and adoption of metrics. Effectiveness of change communication programs. Champion network participation and influence. Achievement of transformation communication objectives. Culture & Leadership Impact Improved employee trust and leadership connectivity. Stronger culture of transparency, inclusion, and recognition. Increased alignment to organizational vision and goals. Enhanced employee experience outcomes. Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Journalism, or related discipline. Master's degree preferred. Experience 8–12+ years of experience in Communications, Employee Engagement, Internal Communications, Organizational Development, Change Management, Human Resources, or related fields. Experience supporting global and matrixed organizations. Proven track record managing enterprise communication and engagement programs. Experience supporting organizational transformation and change adoption initiatives. Critical Skills & Competencies Professional Skills Executive and organizational communications Internal communications strategy Employee engagement and experience Change management Strategic storytelling Event management Stakeholder management Program and project management Communication analytics and insights Content creation and digital communications Leadership Competencies Influencing without authority Strategic thinking Business acumen Customer obsession Relationship building Emotional intelligence Collaboration and partnership Creativity and innovation Resilience and adaptability Inclusive leadership Role Impact Statement The Communications & People Engagement Lead transforms communication into a strategic business capability—connecting people to purpose, enabling organizational change, strengthening culture, elevating employee experience, and building a highly engaged, resilient, customer-obsessed workforce across the Global Customer Care Centers organization. jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Backend Software Engineer to join our Crawler team. In this role, you will design, develop, and operate systems that ingest, process, and manage web-scale data in support of our next generation of advanced search technologies. This is a critical, high-impact engineering position, requiring expertise across both backend and frontend components of our data acquisition stack. Responsibilities - Take ownership of and lead projects focused on developing large-scale web crawlers, ingestion pipelines, and data processing systems. - Build, maintain, and optimize core backend and frontend components for crawler services, including storage, retrieval, and UI dashboards for data management. - Collaborate closely with Search and Infrastructure teams to ensure the reliable, high-quality ingestion and processing of billions of web pages. - Architect and implement fullstack features and scalable distributed systems that handle high-load and real-time data operations. - Rapidly iterate, experiment with novel approaches, and continuously enhance system performance, usability, and reliability. Qualifications - Minimum of 5 years of software development experience, with strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms in at least one of the following languages: Python, C++, Rust, or Go. - Experience with large-scale web crawlers is highly desirable. - Proven experience building, deploying, and optimizing high-load, distributed, and hardware-adjacent services. - Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, with hands-on experience in Kubernetes (K8s) and AWS. - Demonstrated passion for writing clean, efficient, and scalable systems.
